item.title: Trump and Ontario Premier Doug Ford clash over US-Canada trade tensions
item.description: Ford suggested Canada should use all available measures against Trump.

item.title: South Carolina Senate race moves to runoff election today
item.description: Darline Graham, sister of late Sen. Lindsey Graham, competes against Rep. Ralph Norman for GOP nomination.

item.title: FBI offers $25,000 minimum reward for tips on unsolved Indian Country cases
item.description: The FBI has set a minimum reward of $25,000 for information leading to resolution of cold cases involving missing or murdered individuals in Indian Country.

item.title: Supreme Court backs Trump on parts of mail-in voting executive order
item.description: The 6-3 ruling saw liberal justices in dissent.
